sn4.17:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
sn4.17:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ upādāya bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
sn4.17:1.3: te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhikatvā manasikatvā sabbacetaso samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti.
sn4.17:2.2: ayaṃ kho samaṇo gotamo channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ upādāya bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti
sn4.17:2.3: te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhikatvā manasikatvā sabbacetaso samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti
sn4.17:2.4: yannūnāhaṃ yena samaṇo gotamo tenupasaṅkameyyaṃ vicakkhukammāyāti.
sn4.17:2.5: atha kho māro pāpimā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato avidūre mahantaṃ bhayabheravaṃ saddaṃ akāsi apissudaṃ paṭhavī maññe udrīyatīti. atha kho aññataro bhikkhu aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca
sn4.17:2.6: bhikkhu bhikkhu esā paṭhavī maññe udrīyatīti.
sn4.17:2.7: evaṃ vutte bhagavā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca
sn4.17:2.9: māro eso pāpimā tumhākaṃ vicakkhukammāya āgatoti.
sn4.17:2.10: atha kho bhagavā māro ayaṃ pāpimā iti viditvā māraṃ pāpimantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
